# reconcile processes PRs in merge-time order and is idempotent

Reconcile processes backloged PRs ordered by their merge time (merge order), not arrival order, and running reconcile again after success produces no additional work (idempotence / watermark advancement).

Ensure deterministic, ordered processing of PRs and avoid reprocessing already-reconciled PRs.
